desc_en: Fi-dominant: values and personal beliefs are the first principle of action, true to the heart. Ne-auxiliary explores possibilities between ideals and reality, with strong empathy and a pursuit of meaningful work and life.
desc_zh: Fi 主导：价值观和个人信念是第一行动准则，忠于内心。Ne 辅助在理想与现实间探索可能性，同理心强，追求有意义的工作与生活。
